arena_opponents_kind.name: arena_opponents_kind
arena_opponents_kind.value:
case "arena_opponents"."kind"
        when 'npc' then "arena_opponents"."npc_id" is not null and "arena_opponents"."opponent_id" is null and "arena_opponents"."referee_place" is null
        when 'player' then "arena_opponents"."npc_id" is null and "arena_opponents"."opponent_id" is not null and "arena_opponents"."referee_place" is null
        else "arena_opponents"."npc_id" is null and "arena_opponents"."opponent_id" is null and "arena_opponents"."referee_place" between -10 and -1 end

character_bloodlines_active.name: character_bloodlines_active
character_bloodlines_active.value: "character_bloodlines"."active_slot" is null or ("character_bloodlines"."active_slot" between 0 and 2 and "character_bloodlines"."unlocked_at" is not null)

character_souls_socket.name: character_souls_socket
character_souls_socket.value: ("character_souls"."limit_id" is null) = ("character_souls"."socket" is null) and "character_souls"."socket" between 0 and 4

character_talents_active.name: character_talents_active
character_talents_active.value: "character_talents"."active_slot" is null or ("character_talents"."active_slot" between 0 and 2 and "character_talents"."level" >= 1)

mails_kind.name: mails_kind
mails_kind.value:
case when "mails"."category" = 'player'
        then "mails"."subject" is not null and "mails"."body" is not null and "mails"."template_key" is null and "mails"."params" is null
        else "mails"."sender_id" is null and "mails"."subject" is null and "mails"."body" is null and "mails"."template_key" is not null and "mails"."params" is not null end

mails_lengths.name: mails_lengths
mails_lengths.value: char_length("mails"."subject") between 1 and 20 and char_length("mails"."body") between 1 and 200 and char_length("mails"."template_key") between 1 and 100

market_listings_prices.name: market_listings_prices
market_listings_prices.value: ("market_listings"."price_stone" is not null or "market_listings"."price_gold" is not null) and "market_listings"."price_stone" between 1 and 1000000 and "market_listings"."price_gold" between 1 and 1000000

single_gate_auto.name: single_gate_auto
single_gate_auto.value: "single_gate"."mode" between 0 and 2 and "single_gate"."exp_bonus" >= 0 and "single_gate"."auto_runs_left" between 0 and "single_gate"."auto_runs_bought" and "single_gate"."auto_runs_bought" between 0 and 3 and "single_gate"."auto_end_floor" between 1 and 170 and "single_gate"."auto_reach_floor" between 1 and 170
